drills.title: Sharks and Fishes

drills.instructions: Runners cross between end lines; one or two sharks tag them. Tagged runners become sharks next round. Reset until all have crossed.

drills.title: Breakout Touch
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
drills.instructions: Begin in a small marked grid; after a turnover the new attack may break out to the larger scoring area. Reset each try.
drills.coaching: Switch roles quickly; scan outside the grid.
drills.progression: Change breakout direction.

drills.title: Switch Passing
drills.objective: Change direction through a timed support line.
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
drills.instructions: Unopposed, a support runner changes angle behind the carrier and receives a legal pass. Rotate roles and then add touch defence.
drills.coaching: Receiver stays behind ball; communicate; avoid crossing into each other.
drills.progression: Introduce a passive defender.

drills.title: Loop Passing
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
drills.instructions: Carrier passes to support then loops behind that player into a new passing lane. Use unopposed practice first and rotate.
drills.coaching: Run behind receiver; maintain separation; time the return pass.
drills.progression: Add a touch defender.

drills.title: Rugby Tennis
drills.objective: Explore kicking accuracy and space where permitted.
drills.safety: Coach review required. Check current RFU age-grade rules and club policy; do not introduce live contact or set-piece pressure from this card. Kicking only where age-grade rules permit; no contested catches.
drills.instructions: Teams occupy separated areas and send controlled kicks across a marked neutral zone. Opponents collect and return from a safe position. No aerial contests.
drills.coaching: Check safe space; choose controlled distance; watch the ball.
drills.regression: Use hand throws or stationary kicking.
drills.progression: Vary scoring zones within safe distances.

drills.coaching: Accurate throw; ready hands; clear landing space.
drills.progression: Move to a new receiving area before throw.

drills.title: Counter-attack Game
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
drills.instructions: Coach gives possession to either team at intervals during touch rugby. New attackers find support and choose the best route to score.
drills.coaching: Scan first; communicate; attack available space.
drills.progression: Vary turnover locations.

drills.coaching: First support near ball; others create options; stay organised.

drills.title: Order Ball
drills.objective: Move and communicate to receive in sequence.
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
drills.instructions: Number teammates; pass through them in order while opponents try to intercept without contact. Switch on a drop or interception.
drills.coaching: Next receiver moves into a lane; communicate numbers.
drills.progression: Introduce a second ball only when ready.

drills.title: Back-to-back Passing
drills.objective: Develop ball familiarity and trunk control.
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
drills.instructions: Partners stand back to back with comfortable separation, hand the ball around one side and receive on the other. Swap direction.
drills.coaching: Soft hands; controlled movement; don't twist forcefully.
drills.progression: Vary height within comfortable reach.

drills.coaching: Present hands; look before turning; keep spacing.
drills.progression: Vary the direction after a call.

drills.title: Partner Tag
drills.safety: Non-contact version; use light touch or tags only. Check space, surface and player readiness.
